arg_shape_census.lea_rip_global_section_note: all 9 distinct globals lie in .bss (0x64ffe40..0x6728924), so their contents are runtime-filled and not readable from the file
arg_shape_census.method: for each of the 474 sites, linear backward scan (max 40 instructions) in the enclosing FDE's objdump to the nearest instruction writing rdi; objdump comment suffixes stripped before parsing; control-flow merges are NOT resolved, so a shape is the linear predecessor, not a proved dataflow fact

census.e8_method: raw E8 scan over .text file offsets 0x1418300..0x63f0ba0, every site rel32-verified to 0x63bf680; every site additionally confirmed as an objdump call row to 0x63bf680 during per-FDE disassembly (385 FDEs disassembled individually)

packet_232_fde.note: claimed by merged packet #232 (PR #2644); its 3 helper sites are counted in the census but no byte of that FDE is claimed here

g_wait.shows: Two global wait sequences: lea record, call helper, movb $1 to record+0x68 flag, jmp back

r18_try.shows: Trylock on the +0x18 record's mutex: lea 0x58(%rbp), call pthread_mutex_trylock

r18_wait.shows: Wait on the +0x18 record: lea 0x18(%rbp), call helper, movb $1 to 0x80(%rbp) = record+0x68

r28_wait.shows: Wait on the +0x28a8 record: lea 0x28a8(%rbp), call helper, movb $1 to 0x2910(%rbp) = record+0x68

r38_try.shows: Trylock on the +0x38 record's mutex: lea 0x78(%rbx), mov to rdi, call pthread_mutex_trylock

r38_wait.shows: Wait on the +0x38 record: lea 0x38(%rbx), call helper, movb $1 to 0xa0(%rbx) = record+0x68, jmp
